record.where: Controls: one hand for travel, two for trouble · Verification — the mouse-only run, named by its subject

clauses.text: M1 tap on the ground — walk there along a route feet can actually take
a tap across an uncrossable river is refused with "No way through on foot — a ladder or bridge would change that"
M1 tap on a terminal, ruin, crate, cairn, paver, pylon or event — walk there and use it
Hold M1 — steer at the cursor
M1 on the valley map — travel there
If feet stop advancing or six seconds of walking go nowhere, the ground ahead is marked impassable

figure.note: the Walker is wedged so the feet stop advancing; six seconds of walking that go nowhere are not tried

clauses.text: the route re-plans (up to three times) before an honest "The ground stops you here"

figure.note: three re-plans, the marked ground growing, then the walk dropped
